briefdescription.para: Helper: returns true if outer interval fully contains inner interval.

detaileddescription.para: outer covers inner iff outer.lower <= inner.lower AND inner.upper <= outer.upper (with appropriate open/closed boundary handling).

briefdescription.para: Helper: returns true if two intervals have a non-empty intersection.

detaileddescription.para: Endpoint ordering is delegated to checked interval operations; unsupported endpoints are treated conservatively as not proven to overlap.
